opennyai_summary.facts:
The present application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 43/2022, under Sections 420/120B of the IPC, registered at P.S. Cyber Police Station,
South District.
This Court, vide order dated 14.10.2022, granted interim protection to the applicant on his depositing a sum of Rs. 5000/- of the cheated amount, which was alleged to have come in his account and also on the applicant joining the investigation.
Learned APP for the State, on instructions from the Investigating Officer, who is present in the Court today, submits that the applicant has complied with the directions in the order dated 14.10.2022 and has joined the investigation.
opennyai_summary.decision:
It is further submitted on instructions from the Investigating Officer, that the applicant is not required for any custodial interrogation.
In view thereof, the present application is allowed.
In the event of arrest, the present applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Officer, further subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the trial Court.
The applicant shall intimate the trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
iv. The applicant shall join investigation as and when called by the Investigating Officer concerned.
v. The applicant shall provide his mobile number to the Investigating Officer and intimate about any change.
The application is allowed and disposed of accordingly.
Order be uploaded on the website of this court forthwith.
